Subject: POC kickoff + hands-on session (routing prompts + load test)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is eager to move to a hands-on POC focused on: prompt review, routing rules for our customer intents, and a short load validation (burst to ~300 concurrent sessions for 5 minutes).

We want to kick off next week with a 90-minute working session where we can:
- walk through prompt library and prompt templates
- validate routing fallback behavior between standard and low-cost model variants
- run a light load run from our staging environment hitting your staging endpoint

Two asks to unblock scheduling:
1) We need a VPC allowlist (source IP ranges) and the names of the staging endpoints so our cloudops team can open firewall rules.
2) Instructions for provisioning a sandbox API key with request limits for the session (we prefer not to use prod keys).

Are any of these available today? Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 9/1 09:00-10:30, Wed 9/2 13:00-14:30, Thu 9/3 08:00-09:30. If those don't work, send a couple alternatives.

Also please include who from your side will be on the call so we can loop in our security and network folks if needed.

Thanks,
Dana Barnes
Director, AI Integrations
BigRetail Inc.

--
Dana Barnes
BigRetail Inc. | dana.barnes@bigretail.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2026-08-28T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff + hands-on session (routing prompts + load test)

Dana — thanks for the clear brief and proposed slots. All good from our side; we can support the agenda you outlined. A few quick items to unblock the session: 

1) VPC allowlist: attached is our vpc_allowlist_template.json (stub). If you can return it with your egress IPs filled in, our infra team will add them to the staging ACLs. Typical pattern: provide CIDR list + manager contact for short-term whitelisting.

2) Sandbox API key: we can issue a scoped sandbox key with token-level rate limits and a 4-hour TTL. Monica (cc'd) will generate the key once we have the allowlist and confirm the final slot.

3) Staging endpoints: our staging ingestion endpoint is https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/api/v1/generate and the streaming endpoint is https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/stream. These are reachable once allowlist and peering rules are in place.

4) Load test plan: to avoid impacting shared infra, we'll coordinate a controlled burst from your staging namespace. Suggest a one-minute ramp, three-minute steady at target concurrency, one-minute ramp down. We will monitor latency percentiles and provide a post-test CSV.

Availability: Tue 9/1 09:00 PDT works for Marcus + Monica + Soojin. If you'd prefer the afternoon slots we can accommodate 9/2 13:00 PDT as well. Please confirm and provide the cloudops contact for allowlist and a name for the sandbox API owner.

Attachments: vpc_allowlist_template.json (please fill & return), sandbox_credentials_instructions.pdf (explains how we scope sandbox keys).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
